construct_optimizer: build a pytorch SGD optimizer from a model using config-based learning rate, momentum, and weight decay settings
get_epoch_lr: retrieve the learning rate for a given training epoch based on the configured lr policy schedule
set_lr: set the learning rate for all parameter groups in an existing pytorch optimizer to a new value
review_construct_optimizer: review the construct_optimizer function to understand how SGD is configured with momentum and nesterov options
refactor_set_lr: refactor the set_lr function to support per-parameter-group learning rate scheduling
